description: Turn a new rep's start date into a ramp that ends in quota, not confusion. Builds a 30/60/90 onboarding plan with milestones at each gate, a certification bar they have to clear before they carry full load, and the manager touchpoints that catch a slow ramp early. Built for B2B sales managers and enablement, customizable to your role and motion. Trigger on "build an onboarding plan", "30/60/90 for a new AE", "how do I ramp this rep", "certification checklist", "onboarding milestones", or any new-hire ramp.
